meta.description: Analyze TF motif accessibility variability across samples or single cells using chromVAR. Use when identifying TF motifs whose accessibility correlates with conditions, computing per-sample motif z-scores after matched background correction, comparing to ArchR / Signac equivalents, or distinguishing motif-accessibility signal from per-site footprinting.

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabricated values; unexecuted paths and heuristics are labelled; the wrong z-score number (MOTDEV-013) is corrected to |z| about 7 and re-verified against the certified run outputs

practice_boundaries.detail: Research-only genomics skill; no clinical conclusions

methodological_ground.detail: chromVAR core equals hand computation; K562 vs GM12878 contrast recovers GATA/TAL1 versus SPIB/Spi1/IRF/EBF1/PAX5; DecoupleR misuse removed

code_usability.detail: Shipped script runs unmodified with documented depth.tsv and is byte-identical across reruns; Signac direct route and ArchR guard run verbatim

functional_suitability.note: Bulk, Signac and ArchR routes execute and reproduce known biology; the z-score magnitude claim now matches the measured run

reliability.note: depth stopifnot, set.seed and NA guard all verified; ArchR NA cause is guarded not solved and unproven at full scale (stated)

performance_context.note: SKILL.md 77 lines with routed references; method-reference 106 lines but sectioned

agent_usability.note: Clear workflow table and step list; condition vector and genome still hard-coded and flagged for editing

human_usability.note: Outputs use ID (name); heatmap legible; caveats and heuristics labelled

security.note: No credentials, network or destructive operations; local files only

maintainability.note: License and provenance preserved; tested stack stated; Bioc 3.23 not run

agent_specific.note: Trigger-rich description, progressive disclosure, honest labelling of unexecuted paths

inputs.label: Shipped bulk script, unmodified, with depth.tsv on ENCODE GM12878 x3 vs K562 x3 (chr1:1-30 Mb, 6,357 peaks); run twice
inputs.note: Exit 0 twice, CSVs byte-identical; biology correct; SKILL.md numbers match the run

assertions.text: Script exits 0 and writes deviations, variability and differential CSVs plus two PDFs; 879 motifs x 6 samples, 0 NA, 5,340 peaks pass filters
assertions.note: Parsed: 879 x 6, 0 NA; 742 motifs at adj.P.Val<0.05 and |logFC|>=0.5, matching the SKILL.md count

assertions.text: depth.tsv requirement is documented and enforced (stopifnot on sample names)
assertions.note: Documented in SKILL.md steps 1-2 and the script header; guard run in input 2

assertions.text: Two clean-directory runs give byte-identical outputs and the reproducibility comes from set.seed
assertions.note: Runs A and B: identical sha256 for all three CSVs, also identical to fix-run and tooling-delta; a control copy with set.seed removed differs (max |dz| 1.485, significant-set Jaccard 0.866)

assertions.text: Contrast recovers known biology: K562 erythroid GATA/TAL1 up, GM12878 lymphoid SPIB/Spi1/IRF/REL/EBF1/PAX5 up; labels read 'ID (name)'; heatmap legible
assertions.note: GATA2 +8.39, GATA1::TAL1 +6.0, Spi1 -11.05, SPIB -12.32, EBF1 -3.62; heat.png re-drawn from the shipped call shows two clean column blocks and readable row labels

assertions.text: Numeric statements in SKILL.md match the run
assertions.note: SKILL.md now says the top motifs 'reached |z| of about 7 per sample'; certified runs bulk_A and bulk_B (script byte-identical to the candidate) give per-sample max |z| 6.61-7.24, 0 values above 9; 742-motif count unchanged

inputs.note: Guard stops before compute; unseeded control demonstrates the set.seed need

assertions.note: Exit 1 'all(colnames(se) %in% names(depth)) is not TRUE'; directory holds only inputs and logs

assertions.text: Prose claim 'unseeded reruns changed z by up to 1.25 and the significant set by about 12%' is consistent with a fresh control
assertions.note: Observed 1.485 and 13.4% (Jaccard 0.866); the claim is an observed example, not a bound

assertions.text: chromvar assay is 879 motifs x 1,853 cells with 0 NA and a plausible range

assertions.text: Verbatim guard drops the NA cells and getMarkerFeatures completes
assertions.note: 6 cells dropped, 210 remain; C3 34 markers at FDR<=0.05 and MeanDiff>=0.5, other clusters 0

assertions.text: Post-guard MotifMatrix z is NA-free
assertions.note: NA 0, dim 870 x 210

assertions.text: Skill states honestly that full-scale recurrence is untested and gives a report-the-count instruction
assertions.note: single-cell.md: 'Whether this recurs on a full-depth dataset is untested; count NA first and report how many cells were dropped'; SKILL.md guardrail says check and drop first

assertions.text: Full-scale recurrence or a root-cause fix is demonstrated
assertions.note: Not tested (slice only, 216 cells); C3 hits (OTX2, KDM2B, HOXB2, VAX2) are not PBMC-plausible, consistent with the stated weakness at this size

key_strengths: Both former P0s verified fixed independently: the unmodified bulk script runs with depth.tsv and outputs are byte-identical across clean reruns, while removing set.seed demonstrably breaks reproducibility
Signac direct chromVAR route runs verbatim on 1.17.1 and 1.16.0 with identical 879 x 1,853 NA-free results
ArchR NA failure reproduced without the guard and resolved with it; the Skill states honestly that full-scale recurrence is untested
Biology matches the cell lines: K562 GATA1/GATA2/TAL1 up, GM12878 SPIB/Spi1/IRF/REL/EBF1/PAX5 up, with readable ID (name) labels
Provenance, license and tested-stack statement retained; DecoupleR misuse removed

recommendations.title: ArchR NA z-scores guarded, not root-caused (MOTDEV-004)
recommendations.problem: The guard drops NA cells so getMarkerFeatures completes, but recurrence at full depth is untested and dropped cells change cluster composition.
recommendations.root_cause: Zero-read motif peaks give zero background SD in sparse cells; not investigated at full scale.
recommendations.fix: Optionally test on whole-genome PBMC 5k fragments and add a minimum-fragment cell filter before addDeviationsMatrix if NA recurs.
